headline: Independently Held Fuel Oil Stocks in ARA Region Increase 10% in November
summary: Independent fuel oil inventories in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp hub averaged 6.16 million barrels in November so far, up 10% from October levels, according to Insights Global data.
why: The ARA region is Northwest Europe's main refining and oil storage trading hub.

impacts.name: Fuel Oil
impacts.why: Independent fuel oil inventories in the ARA hub expanded by 10% month-over-month.
